newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hellaby to buy 51 pct of Hannahs.
newsitem.headline: Hellaby to buy 51 pct of Hannahs.

text.p: Hellaby Holdings Ltd on Monday said it had exercised its option to subscribe for 51 percent of the shareholding in R. Hannah and Co, New Zealand's largest footwear retailer, with settlement due on March 31.
"To give effect to this option Hannahs will issue 21.649 million new shares to Hellaby at a price of one cent per share," Hellaby said.

"Consistent with this policy Hellaby has agreed to on-sell to Michael Beagley, Chief Executive of Hannahs, a 12.75 percent stake in Hannahs and $1.25 million of the subordinated secured debt on the same terms and conditions as between Hellaby and Hannahs."
Hellaby's equity interest in Hannahs would accordingly become 38.25 percent with its subordinated secured debt exposure reducing to $9.25 million.
Hellaby and Beagley retain an option to subscribe for a further 23.9 percent of the shareholding in Hannahs after January 1, 1999, at the then market price.
If this second option is exercised, Hellaby's shareholding would increase to 56.2 percent of the issued capital of Hannahs.
